accounting.rationale: J3/24-007 PDF 47, printed 33, lines 20-23 states the Fortran 2018 compatibility baseline and exception boundary.
Except for identified incompatibilities, this document is an upward-compatible extension to Fortran 2018.
A standard-conforming Fortran 2018 program remains conforming under this document only if it avoids features identified in this subclause as no longer permitted.

PDF 47 lines 24-27 summarizes changed SYSTEM_CLOCK argument restrictions. The existing owner is doc/catalogues/system_clock_16_9_202.json: S16.9.202-001 covers the decimal exponent range and same-kind argument restrictions.
Integer SYSTEM_CLOCK arguments now need decimal exponent range at least as large as a default integer; existing owner doc/catalogues/system_clock_16_9_202.json S16.9.202-001 covers this restriction.
All integer arguments in one SYSTEM_CLOCK reference now need the same kind type parameter; existing owner doc/catalogues/system_clock_16_9_202.json S16.9.202-001 covers this restriction.
PDF 47 lines 28-30 summarizes the current DATA-before-use restriction for BLOCK construct entities; existing owner doc/catalogues/statement_and_construct_entities_19_4.json S19.4-004 covers the rule.

A construct entity declared only by DATA initialization shall not be used before that DATA statement; existing owner doc/catalogues/statement_and_construct_entities_19_4.json S19.4-004 covers this restriction.

PDF 47 lines 31-32 summarizes the ASSOCIATED rank incompatibility. Existing owner doc/catalogues/associated_intrinsic_16_9_20.json S16.9.20-007 covers the data-pointer POINTER/TARGET same-rank restriction.

POINTER and TARGET arguments to ASSOCIATED may no longer have different rank; existing owner doc/catalogues/associated_intrinsic_16_9_20.json S16.9.20-007 covers non-assumed-rank POINTER/TARGET same rank.

PDF 48 lines 1-12 lists Fortran 2018 features that might have a different interpretation. The bullets are compatibility notices with exact existing owners named on their fine units, not new local facets.

Deferred-length allocatable character assignment by IOMSG=, ERRMSG=, internal WRITE unit usage, or intrinsic subroutine INTENT(OUT) now follows intrinsic assignment semantics. Existing main owners confirmed: doc/catalogues/assignment.json section 10.2.1.3 covers intrinsic-assignment allocation/length effects, doc/catalogues/iomsg_specifier_12_11_6.json covers IOMSG assignment, doc/catalogues/errmsg_specifier_9_7_5.json covers ERRMSG assignment, and doc/catalogues/internal_files_12_4.json S12.4-007 covers deferred-length scalar internal output.

The document permits SYSTEM_CLOCK to use two or more clocks with characteristics based on argument type and kind; existing owner doc/catalogues/system_clock_16_9_202.json covers this latitude in S16.9.202-008 and clock selection in S16.9.202-009.

IEEE_MAX_NUM, IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG, IEEE_MIN_NUM, and IEEE_MIN_NUM_MAG now return the number for a number/signaling-NaN pair; existing owners are doc/catalogues/ieee_max_num_17_11_19.json S17.11.19-008, doc/catalogues/ieee_max_num_mag_17_11_20.json S17.11.20-008, doc/catalogues/ieee_min_num_17_11_23.json S17.11.23-006, and doc/catalogues/ieee_min_num_mag_17_11_24.json S17.11.24-005.
